description: Build the EHR backend for reading and sending email: a dependency-free raw-email parser/sanitizer helper and two API routes under app/api/ehr/email/ (inbox list + single message, and send/reply). Reuses the existing auth, audit, and S3 helpers and the repo's hand-signed SES v2 REST technique (NO new npm dependency — do not add @aws-sdk/client-ses or a MIME parser). Depends on FEAT-001 for the bucket, IAM (ses:SendEmail/SendRawEmail + inbound bucket access), and Amplify env vars; the routes degrade to configured:false when env vars are absent so the build is always safe. Build signal is the Amplify job for the commit.
steps: Create lib/ehr/inbound-email.ts (no imports beyond node builtins). Export parseRawEmail(raw: string|Buffer): { from; to; subject; date; messageId; text; html } — split headers from body on the first blank line, unfold folded headers, detect multipart/* via the boundary param and walk parts, decode base64 and quoted-printable, prefer text/plain else sanitized text/html. Export sanitizeHtml(html: string): string removing <script>/<style>/<iframe>, on*= handler attributes, and javascript:/data: URLs. Export small key helpers (e.g. isInboundKey(prefix,key), messageIdFromKey) mirroring the style of lib/ehr/document-storage.ts.

Create app/api/ehr/email/inbox/route.ts modeled on app/api/ehr/fax/inbox/route.ts. Add export const dynamic='force-dynamic' and export const runtime='nodejs'. In GET(request): const actor = await requireEhrActor(request); requireRole(actor, ['owner','provider']); read process.env.EHR_INBOUND_EMAIL_BUCKET / EHR_INBOUND_EMAIL_REGION / EHR_INBOUND_EMAIL_PREFIX. If unset, return NextResponse.json({ configured:false, items:[], nextCursor:null }, { headers:{ 'Cache-Control':'no-store' } }). Else build a dedicated new S3Client({ region: EHR_INBOUND_EMAIL_REGION }) (do NOT use getS3Client(), which is us-east-2). With no ?id: ListObjectsV2Command under the prefix, map to lightweight items { id:key, size, receivedAt:LastModified }, paginate via ContinuationToken (base64url cursor like the fax route), appendAuditEvent(actor,{ action:'Viewed email inbox', category:'Email', entityType:'inbound-email' }). With ?id=<key>: validate the key begins with the prefix and matches a safe charset, GetObjectCommand, read the body to a string, parseRawEmail + sanitizeHtml, return { from,to,subject,date,text,html }, appendAuditEvent(actor,{ action:'Opened email message', category:'Email', entityType:'inbound-email', entityId:key }). Never log message bodies.

Create app/api/ehr/email/send/route.ts. Extract the SigV4 signing helpers into lib/ehr/ses-send.ts (sha256Hex, signingKey, and a sendSesV2({from,to,subject,text,html?,headers?}) that POSTs https://email.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v2/email/outbound-emails reusing new DynamoDBClient({region:'us-east-1'}).config.credentials()), then refactor lib/ehr/booking-alert-email.ts, lib/ehr/patient-invite-email.ts, and lib/site/send-contact-email.ts to import from it (keep each public function signature and return-string behavior identical so nothing breaks). In POST(request): const actor = await requireEhrActor(request); requireRole(actor, ['owner','provider']); parse { to, subject, text, inReplyTo? }; validate recipients are non-empty strings; send FromEmailAddress connect@rlth.org (process.env.EHR_SES_FROM_ADDRESS || 'connect@rlth.org') with ReplyToAddresses=[that address]; when inReplyTo is present, set In-Reply-To/References (use SES v2 raw/headers path); appendAuditEvent(actor,{ action:'Sent email', category:'Email', entityType:'outbound-email', summary:'Provider sent an email from connect@rlth.org' }) with NO body text in the summary; return NextResponse.json({ status }). Wrap handlers in try/catch returning apiErrorResponse(error).

If extracting ses-send.ts proves risky, the acceptable alternative is to copy the signing block into send/route.ts verbatim (as the three existing senders each do) and leave them untouched; record the choice in findings.
acceptance_criteria: The Amplify build for the pushed commit succeeds (next build green) with the new files; no new entry was added to package.json dependencies.
Authenticated GET /api/ehr/email/inbox as an owner returns { configured:true, items:[...] } once FEAT-001 env vars are set, and lists any object delivered under the inbound/ prefix.
GET /api/ehr/email/inbox?id=<key> returns parsed { from,to,subject,date,text,html } with html sanitized (no <script>/<iframe>/on*=).
POST /api/ehr/email/send with { to, subject, text } from an owner returns { status:'sent' } and writes an audit event category 'Email' with no body text; a client-role token gets HTTP 403.
booking-alert-email, patient-invite-email, and send-contact-email still compile and still send (their return strings unchanged).
verification: Commit on aws-ehr-production and confirm the Amplify deploy job is green (the build signal; no local tsc).
After deploy, exercise the three endpoints authenticated as owner/provider and confirm the documented JSON and audit entries; confirm a non-owner/provider role is rejected with 403.
Grep package.json to confirm no mailparser/@aws-sdk/client-ses was added.
findings:
Implemented all FEAT-002 code. Files created: lib/ehr/inbound-email.ts (node-builtin-only raw RFC822 parser: splits headers/body on first blank line, unfolds folded headers, walks multipart/* via boundary param, decodes base64 and quoted-printable, prefers text/plain else sanitized text/html; exports parseRawEmail, sanitizeHtml, isInboundKey, messageIdFromKey); app/api/ehr/email/inbox/route.ts (dynamic+runtime=nodejs, requireEhrActor+requireRole(['owner','provider']), reads EHR_INBOUND_EMAIL_BUCKET/REGION/PREFIX, returns {configured:false,...} when unset, builds its OWN new S3Client({region}) per context.json, ListObjectsV2 -> items {id,size,receivedAt}, base64url ContinuationToken cursor, ?id= path validates key via isInboundKey then GetObject -> parseRawEmail, audit 'Viewed email inbox'/'Opened email message' category 'Email', no body logged, Cache-Control no-store); app/api/ehr/email/send/route.ts (role gate, parses {to,subject,text,inReplyTo?}, validates non-empty recipients+text, FromEmailAddress + ReplyToAddresses = EHR_SES_FROM_ADDRESS||connect@rlth.org, sets In-Reply-To/References via SES v2 raw path when inReplyTo present, audit 'Sent email' category 'Email' with NO body in summary, returns {status:'sent'}, apiErrorResponse on throw).

Chose the EXTRACT option (step 3, not the step-4 fallback): created lib/ehr/ses-send.ts holding the single copy of sha256Hex, signingKey, and a new sendSesV2({from,to,subject,text,html?,cc?,replyTo?,headers?}) that signs SigV4 by hand and POSTs https://email.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v2/email/outbound-emails, reusing new DynamoDBClient({region:'us-east-1'}).config.credentials(). Uses Simple content normally and the Raw (base64 MIME) path when custom headers (In-Reply-To/References) are present. Refactored booking-alert-email.ts, patient-invite-email.ts, and send-contact-email.ts to import sendSesV2; each public function signature and every return string is preserved verbatim ('sent','not-configured','email-pending-ses','email-error', and patient-invite's detailed 'email-failed: SES <code> - <detail>' path, which now reads result.response).

NO new npm dependency added: grep of package.json confirms no @aws-sdk/client-ses and no mailparser.

VERIFICATION LIMITATION: this workflow step is constrained to commit locally and NEVER push. The build signal for this repo is the AWS Amplify deploy job (app d1mwc7x488m8xn, branch aws-ehr-production), which only runs after a push, and the live endpoints can only be exercised once deployed. Because pushing is out of scope for this step, the Amplify-green confirmation and the live owner/provider/403 endpoint exercise COULD NOT be performed here and must be run by the integrating caller after it pushes this commit, and after FEAT-001 provisions the bucket/IAM/env vars. Local checks that WERE performed: no new dependency in package.json; all three refactored senders compile against the new ses-send.ts exports with unchanged signatures; the two new routes import only existing helpers (auth, dynamodb-store, inbound-email) plus @aws-sdk/client-s3 (already a dependency, used by the fax route). No local tsc/next build is available on this machine per context.json.
